name: Current and Emerging Issues in Strategic Management
description:
This course contains the following topics:
Introduction to Innovation, Strategic Thinking 
External Factors: Environmental challenges, Privacy, Government Policy Artificial Intelligence, Digital strategies, automation, Industry 4.0 
Internal Factors: Organizational design and competitive edge- Vision, Mission and Logic, External collaborations, Value creation and Value capture
Creating and capturing innovation, Disruptive Innovations, Design Thinking 
The Strategy Process in Changing Environment: Agility and Risk (Role of Ambidexterity)
Thinking Beyond the Strategy: Design Revolution
